concept: Heritage leather-craft palette for Lindsay's Leather and Shoe Repair: a rich saddle-brown primary evokes hand-tooled leather and decades of craftsmanship, deepened by an oxblood secondary that nods to polished dress shoes. A warm brass accent supplies the artisanal gleam of buckles and stitching hardware, deep espresso ink reads like a cobbler's hand-stamped lettering, and warm parchment backgrounds keep the experience traditional, trustworthy, and inviting.
contrastNotes: All WCAG-AA targets hold against the warm parchment bg #F6EEE0 (L=0.838). Ink #2A1C12 on bg = 14.31:1 (>=7). Ink-soft #6E5239 on bg = 6.22:1 (>=4.5). White on primary saddle-brown #7A3B22 = 8.48:1 (>=4.5). Primary-dark #592512 on bg = 10.73:1 (>=4.5) and carries white at 12.37:1 for hover/active. Primary on bg = 7.36:1 (>=3). Brass accent #C8972F on near-black #000 = 7.92:1 (>=3) for bright pops on dark heroes. CRITICAL surface-alt #EFE2CC is a LIGHT parchment tint (slightly deeper than bg): ink on surface-alt = 12.90:1 (>=7). Bonus: ink on surface #FFFCF6 = 16.11:1; white on oxblood secondary #5E2027 = 12.27:1. Brass accent is reserved for decorative gleam, dividers, and large display text, not body copy on light bg (2.3:1).
